column1: # RDR-229 P3.3a (nexus-p2m1x.19): the one list of the seven id-twin foreign keys, each added NOT VALID beside its name key, and of the
# validation move that validates it. Read by the boot-time completion check (FkTwins), by the changesets' tests and by the operator docs.
# Columns: table, fk_columns (the referencing columns, comma separated), referenced_columns (on nexus.catalog_collections, same order),
#          twin (the constraint name), on_delete (the name key's own action, which the twin copies), label (the validation move), name_key.
# ON UPDATE is NO ACTION on every twin: a collection id never changes (the name key's ON UPDATE CASCADE carries a rename; the id does not move).
# The id UNIQUE keys the twins reference are vectors-068-1's: (tenant_id, collection_id) and (tenant_id, collection_id, embedding_model).
# aspect_extraction_queue is absent on most installs (R3): its twin and move are guarded, and its label counts as not applicable there
# (StampLabels.NOT_APPLICABLE_WHEN_ABSENT). Row order is the order of the changesets in vectors-072-collection-id-fk-twins.xml.
# Out of scope: chunks_collection_fk and the three child keys into nexus.chunks (P3.3c).
